e31.name: Crocodiles of spell 31

descriptions.default: Crocodiles guard the road.
descriptions.settled: They come to take the magic of the deceased. Turned back with the spear.

e31.reference: Davis 1894; spell summary, the rest is game text

e32.name: Crocodiles of spell 32

descriptions.default: Crocodiles wait on both sides.
descriptions.settled: One for each quarter of the sky. Turned back two at a time.

e32.reference: Davis 1894; spell summary, the rest is game text

e33.name: The lunging snake

descriptions.default: A coiled snake blocks the way.
descriptions.settled: Spell 33, against a snake. Struck three times as it sprang.

e33.reference: Davis 1894; spell summary, the rest is game text

e35.name: The snakes on the ground

descriptions.default: A snake lies on the ground.
descriptions.settled: Spell 35. Fourteen snakes speared as they darted in.

e35.reference: Davis 1894; spell summary, the rest is game text

e36.name: The Apshai beetle

descriptions.default: The Apshai beetles dart across the road.
descriptions.settled: Spell 36. Pinned with the point of the spear.

e36.reference: Davis 1894; the name "Apshai" is not in Davis (unsourced); the rest is game text

e37.name: The two Merti snakes

descriptions.default: Two Merti snakes wait on either side.
descriptions.settled: Spell 37. Each struck twice as it sprang.

e37.reference: Davis 1894; Weber 2022 (the Merety, two goddesses often shown as snakes); the rest is game text

e38.name: The breath of life

descriptions.default: The signs of life and breath are offered to you. Only one can be taken.
descriptions.settled: Spell 38, for living on air. One sign taken from his hand.

e38.reference: Davis 1894; Mosher 2022 (the ankh and air signs, and the two mrty-snakes); the rest is game text

e39.name: Apep

descriptions.default: Apep stretches across the road.
descriptions.settled: Spell 39, repelling Apep. Every wave of him pressed down at the spear point.

e39.reference: Davis 1894; Lucarelli 2022 (Apophis, with Rerek as an earlier form); the rest is game text

e40.name: The Eater of the Ass

descriptions.default: The Eater of the Ass
descriptions.settled: Spell 40. Followed along the donkey's back and struck three times as it lifted its head; the donkey spared.

e40.speech: Follow the snake along the donkey's back and strike it three times, without spearing the ass beneath it.
e40.speaker: Scribe
e40.reference: Davis 1894; spell summary, the rest is game text

e41.name: The snake in the sheaf

descriptions.default: Something stirs inside the sheaf.
descriptions.settled: Spell 41. Speared through the sheaf, and pinned on top of it.

e41.reference: Davis 1894; spell summary, the rest is game text

descriptions.default: A chapter about repelling the reptiles that come to take off the man's magic charms in the Netherworld.
A chapter about repelling the crocodiles coming to deprive the deceased from his magic power in the Netherworld.
A chapter about repelling any reptile.
A chapter about not letting the man be devoured by any reptile in the Netherworld.
A chapter about opposing the flesh eating insects.
A chapter about opposing the two eyed-ureus.
A chapter about living by the breath of air in the Netherworld. It is said to oppose the asps.
A chapter about opposing serpent-Rekrek in the Netherworld.
A chapter about repelling the Eater of the Ass.
A chapter about preventing being injured in the Netherworld.
